functionEntry.name: levelColor
functionEntry.documentation: Status level (Status.GOOD .. Status.NONE) to its colour.

functionEntry.name: isoWeek
functionEntry.documentation: ISO 8601 week number (1..53).

functionEntry.name: minutesToHhmm
functionEntry.documentation: Local minutes after midnight (may be fractional) to "07:47", always 24-hour.

functionEntry.name: dateShort
functionEntry.documentation: "SAT 07" for the always-on screen.

functionEntry.name: dateLine
functionEntry.documentation: "SAT 07 NOV W45"

functionEntry.name: isoDayOfWeek
functionEntry.documentation: ISO 8601 day of week: Monday = 1 ... Sunday = 7 (Sakamoto's method).

functionEntry.name: timeString
functionEntry.documentation: "07:58" in 24-hour mode, "7:58" in 12-hour mode (follows the watch setting).

functionEntry.name: hourString
functionEntry.documentation: Hours only: "07" in 24-hour mode, "7" in 12-hour mode.

functionEntry.name: dateParts
functionEntry.documentation: Date split for two-tone drawing: ["SAT ", "07", " NOV · W45"].

functionEntry.name: weeksInYear
functionEntry.documentation:
A year has 53 ISO weeks if it starts on Thursday,
or on Wednesday in a leap year.

functionEntry.name: fillColor
functionEntry.documentation: Scale fill: white for a normal value would be too heavy, so soft grey.

functionEntry.name: offsetX
functionEntry.documentation: Horizontal AOD offset in pixels for the given minute.

functionEntry.name: showSeconds
functionEntry.documentation:
Seconds are only drawn in high-power mode; AMOLED watch faces
cannot use onPartialUpdate for per-second updates in low power.

functionEntry.name: offsetY
functionEntry.documentation: Vertical AOD offset in pixels for the given minute.

functionEntry.name: phase
functionEntry.documentation: Phase of the day from solar elevation and sunrise / sunset minutes.

functionEntry.name: fill
functionEntry.documentation:
Fills slot for kind from current data. All formatting happens here,
once per minute, so drawing allocates nothing.

functionEntry.name: hrTicks
functionEntry.documentation: Heart-rate scale 40..top with notches at rest + 10, zone 1 top, zone 3 top.

functionEntry.name: <globals/WeatherInfo/<>temperature>
functionEntry.documentation: Rounded temperature in the units chosen on the watch, typographic minus.

functionEntry.name: <globals/Readiness/<>topReasons>
functionEntry.documentation: Up to two reasons, the most severe first.

functionEntry.name: rhrDelta
functionEntry.documentation: Today's resting HR minus the personal or Garmin norm.

functionEntry.name: radial
functionEntry.documentation: Short radial line at a minute of day, between radii r0 and r1.

functionEntry.name: colorOf
functionEntry.documentation: Bucket value to colour; -1 (no data) draws a faint track.

functionEntry.name: graphicsAngle
functionEntry.documentation: Minute of day to a Graphics angle (degrees, 0 = 3 o'clock, counter-clockwise).

functionEntry.name: drawSummary
functionEntry.documentation: "READY BB 78 · NIGHT +54": the verdict in its status colour, reasons in grey.

functionEntry.name: drawHorizon
functionEntry.documentation:
Horizon line and sunrise / sunset times under it.
The sun itself is part of the sky (SkyRenderer), behind the mountains.

functionEntry.name: drawBattery
functionEntry.documentation: Thin arc at the edge plus "72% 9D" under it. Colour follows the status.

functionEntry.name: drawTime
functionEntry.documentation: HH:MM in thin digits with a grey colon; cyan seconds to the right.

functionEntry.name: drawWeather
functionEntry.documentation: Weather parts separated by wide gaps, each in its own status colour.

functionEntry.name: drawDate
functionEntry.documentation: "SAT 07 NOV · W45" in grey with the day number in white.

functionEntry.name: <globals/HealthData/<>firstLast>
functionEntry.documentation: [first value, last value, first time, last time] of a history, or null.

functionEntry.name: rhrToday
functionEntry.documentation: Today's resting HR: our night estimate, else the system value.

functionEntry.name: complicationFor
functionEntry.documentation: Complication used to open the native widget for a slot kind.

functionEntry.name: <globals/HealthData/<>nightCharge>
functionEntry.documentation:
Overnight Body Battery charge: lowest value in the night window (one hour
margin on both sides), then the highest value after it until 2 h after wake.

functionEntry.name: runJob
functionEntry.documentation: Runs at most one pending history job. Returns true if a job ran.

functionEntry.name: <globals/HealthData/<>updateNightWindow>
functionEntry.documentation:
Night window from the typical sleep and wake times in the user profile
(defaults 23:00 and 07:00). wakeEnd is today's wake time; before it, the
window of the night in progress.

functionEntry.name: <globals/HealthData/<>history>
functionEntry.documentation: SensorHistory iterator for the last `seconds`, oldest sample first.

functionEntry.name: <globals/HealthData/<>averageStress>
functionEntry.documentation: Mean stress between two moments, ignoring samples without a value.

functionEntry.name: <globals/HealthData/<>readStress>
functionEntry.documentation: Stress is not measured during movement: the system then returns null.

functionEntry.name: <globals/HealthData/<>nightSpo2Min>
functionEntry.documentation: Lowest SpO2 reading of the night (only exists with sleep Pulse Ox enabled).

functionEntry.name: <globals/HealthData/<>nightRestingHr>
functionEntry.documentation:
Resting HR as Garmin defines it: the lowest 30-minute mean. HR samples of
the night go into 5-minute bins; the lowest mean of 6 consecutive bins
that all have data is the result.

functionEntry.name: <globals/HealthData/<>compNumber>
functionEntry.documentation: Numeric value of a system complication, or null.

functionEntry.name: <globals/HealthData/<>computeRing>
functionEntry.documentation: 24 h of Body Battery into 15-minute buckets by local time of day.

functionEntry.name: refreshHeartRate
functionEntry.documentation: Heart rate only, for the 1 Hz high-power period.

functionEntry.name: refresh
functionEntry.documentation: Cheap refresh of current values. Call once per minute and on wake-up.

functionEntry.name: <globals/HealthData/<>newestSample>
functionEntry.documentation: The newest sample of a history, or null.

functionEntry.name: <globals/HealthData/<>computeDailyAverages>
functionEntry.documentation: 7-day calorie average from ActivityMonitor daily history.

functionEntry.name: <globals/HealthData/<>computePressureTrend>
functionEntry.documentation:
3-hour weather pressure tendency in hPa.
The barometer measures station pressure, which also changes when the user
changes altitude (about 0.12 hPa per metre near sea level). The elevation
change over the same window is added back, so a climb or an elevator ride is
not shown as a falling barometer: dP_weather = dP_station + 0.12 * dh.
Values beyond +-15 hPa / 3 h are physically implausible and are dropped.

functionEntry.name: stress
functionEntry.documentation: Stress, Garmin bands: 0-25 REST, 26-50 LOW, 51-75 MED, 76-100 HIGH.

functionEntry.name: bodyBattery
functionEntry.documentation: Body Battery, Garmin bands: 0-25 LOW, 26-50 MED, 51-75 HIGH, 76-100 PEAK.

functionEntry.name: goal
functionEntry.documentation: Progress towards a goal: "64%" or "GOAL".

functionEntry.name: charge
functionEntry.documentation: Overnight Body Battery charge: how well the night restored energy.

functionEntry.name: respiration
functionEntry.documentation: Breaths per minute at rest: 12-20 is the typical adult range.

functionEntry.name: recovery
functionEntry.documentation: Garmin recovery time in hours.

functionEntry.name: heartRate
functionEntry.documentation:
Current heart rate against the user's resting HR and HR zones.
zones = UserProfile.getHeartRateZones(): [z1 min, z1 max, z2 max, z3 max, z4 max, z5 max].

functionEntry.name: spo2
functionEntry.documentation: Blood oxygen from the wrist sensor: indicative only.

functionEntry.name: restingDelta
functionEntry.documentation:
Resting HR today against Garmin's 7-day average: the delta is the status.
+4 bpm and more is a common early sign of fatigue, stress or illness.

functionEntry.name: relative
functionEntry.documentation: Value relative to the user's own 7-day average: "92%".

functionEntry.name: <globals/SkyRenderer/<>expf>
functionEntry.documentation: e^x. Toybox.Math has no exp(), so it is built from pow() and the constant E.

functionEntry.name: update
functionEntry.documentation:
Recomputes colours when the sun moved enough to be visible.
elevation in degrees, dayFraction 0 at sunrise .. 1 at sunset.

functionEntry.name: <globals/SkyRenderer/<>noise>
functionEntry.documentation: 1-D value noise with quintic interpolation.

functionEntry.name: <globals/SkyRenderer/<>quantize>
functionEntry.documentation: Rounds v to the nearest multiple of step, clamped to 0..255.

functionEntry.name: <globals/SkyRenderer/<>readable>
functionEntry.documentation: Soft luminance cap for light text on a dark theme (shader gfx_readable).

functionEntry.name: draw
functionEntry.documentation: Draws the full background: sky rows (equal neighbours merged), sun, ridges.

functionEntry.name: <globals/SkyRenderer/<>fbm>
functionEntry.documentation: Five-octave fbm normalised to 0..1.

functionEntry.name: <globals/SkyRenderer/<>skyAt>
functionEntry.documentation: Shader sky colour at height py, before luminance capping.

functionEntry.name: <globals/SkyRenderer/<>compose>
functionEntry.documentation: gfx_readable + gfx_compose: cap luminance, then mix with the backdrop.

functionEntry.name: <globals/SkyRenderer/<>buildHill>
functionEntry.documentation: Ridge polygon sampled every 8 px (53 points + 2 corners, under the 64 limit).

functionEntry.name: <globals/SkyRenderer/<>hash>
functionEntry.documentation: Sine-free hash (Hoskins), as in the shader.

functionEntry.name: mean
functionEntry.documentation: Personal mean of a field, or null with too little history.

functionEntry.name: lastDay
functionEntry.documentation: Day number of the newest record, or -1 when empty.

functionEntry.name: <globals/Baseline/<>statsOf>
functionEntry.documentation: [mean, standard deviation] over stored values, or null below MIN_DAYS.

functionEntry.name: store
functionEntry.documentation: Appends one record for dayNumber (days since epoch), once per day.

functionEntry.name: isAnomaly
functionEntry.documentation:
True when value is further than 2 sigma from the personal mean.
A floor on sigma keeps a very stable history from flagging tiny changes.

functionEntry.name: elevation
functionEntry.documentation:
Sun elevation above the horizon in degrees (negative below it).
lat/lon in degrees (east positive), tzHours includes daylight saving.

functionEntry.name: declination
functionEntry.documentation: Solar declination in radians.

functionEntry.name: equationOfTime
functionEntry.documentation: Equation of time in minutes.

functionEntry.name: sunTimes
functionEntry.documentation:
Sunrise and sunset in local minutes after midnight, using the standard
-0.833 degree horizon (refraction plus solar radius).
Returns null during polar day or polar night.

functionEntry.name: gamma
functionEntry.documentation: Fractional year in radians for a day of year and local minutes after midnight.

functionEntry.name: onExitSleep
functionEntry.documentation: The user raised the wrist: switch to the full presentation, fresh data.

functionEntry.name: onLayout
functionEntry.documentation: Called once the screen size is known. All geometry is computed here, once.

functionEntry.name: slotKindAt
functionEntry.documentation: Slot index under a screen point, or -1. Used by the touch delegate.

functionEntry.name: onEnterSleep
functionEntry.documentation: The watch went back to sleep: switch to the always-on presentation.

functionEntry.name: onUpdate
functionEntry.documentation: Called every minute in low-power mode and every second in high-power mode.

functionEntry.name: px
functionEntry.documentation: Converts a coordinate designed for 416 px into this screen's pixels.

functionEntry.name: refresh
functionEntry.documentation: Recomputes everything. Call once per minute, never per frame.

functionEntry.name: <globals/SolarState/<>updateLocation>
functionEntry.documentation:
Takes the position from the weather cache; saves it only when it moved,
to avoid needless flash writes.

functionEntry.name: onStart
functionEntry.documentation: Called once when the application starts.

functionEntry.name: onSettingsChanged
functionEntry.documentation:
Called when the user changes settings in Garmin Connect Mobile.
Settings are added in a later step; for now just redraw.

functionEntry.name: getInitialView
functionEntry.documentation: Returns the watch face view and its touch delegate.

functionEntry.name: onStop
functionEntry.documentation: Called when the application is about to stop.
